turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My car insurance renewal came through and it's gone up loads. I haven't even claimed.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's frustrating, and sadly common. Renewal prices are often higher than what new customers get offered.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Get a few comparison quotes first. Then you can either switch, or call your current insurer and ask them to match it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Quite often, yes. Insurers would rather keep you than lose you. Be polite but clear that you have a cheaper offer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Anything else that brings it down?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A higher voluntary excess lowers the price, and so can paying annually instead of monthly. Just make sure the excess is an amount you could actually afford.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good luck. Ten minutes of boredom could save you a decent chunk.
